status: Locked while the first target-free cue extraction was running and before any newly extracted cue or remaining-case future score was completed or inspected.
claim_boundary: Post-open method development on the previously examined PhysTwin-19 cohort. The result may reject the method or justify a genuinely fresh-object preregistration, but it cannot establish confirmation, calibration, or state of the art.

development_history.threshold_selection_evidence: Released manual-prefix landmark diagnostics showed that persistent three-view support corrected two severe source-depth identity errors while lower-availability support could be harmful.
development_history.remaining_cases: The other 16 cases had been opened by prior studies, but had not been extracted or scored for this multiview-priority method at lock time.

method.name: three_view_identity_priority_with_source_depth_fallback
method.source_channel: CoTracker3 source-camera track lifted through source-camera RGB-D
method.priority_channel: CoTracker3 tracks triangulated from at least three calibrated camera views
method.routing_rule: An identity meeting the availability threshold uses only three-view observations throughout the prefix; every other identity exactly retains the source-depth channel. Missing priority-channel rows are not filled from source depth.
method.association: Exact archived PhysTwin graph identity; no state-residual-dependent association or reliability.
method.selection: Use only released prefix object-cloud Chamfer on the nested prefix validation interval.
method.physical_backbone: Object-disjoint MatPhys spring-family replay selected before this observation experiment.

information_boundary.manual_tracks_role: Evaluation only after candidate predictions and selections are fixed.

evaluation.primary_comparator: Identical CoTracker3 extraction, physical backbone, endpoint filter, and causal selector using source-camera RGB-D lifting for every identity.

forbidden: changing the 0.40 availability threshold after inspecting any remaining future score
trying a two-view replacement after its development diagnostic retained the catastrophic sign error
using future CoTracker3, object-cloud, or manual-track values to form or select a prediction
describing this post-open cohort as independent, confirmatory, or state of the art
opening any held-v8 or PokeFlex target artifact
